2893-3470-5455-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

280-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-2033-3249-4242.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-4242.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7893-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-7893-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-6662-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-6662-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

628-728-7217.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-5070.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-6763-7885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

719-997-3413.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2976-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1580-4556-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

969-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4559-6797-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-6797-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-2730-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6709-7328.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

11-799-1927-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-799-1927-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Karn's Temporal Sundering from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2034-4364-4681-6332.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2034-4364-4681-6332.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Aurelia and Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-3967-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3951-5703-5744-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-5744-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

710-772-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

220-428-1946-3604.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
220-428-1946-3604.description:
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 4 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 15, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 15, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 15 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of the token Ghyrson Starn.
Repeat from step 15.

985-1182-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

135-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sluggishness, adding {2}.
Sluggishness triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Sluggishness by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

3496-4071-4625-4875.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3121-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Servos, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the tokens die, Marionette Master triggers twice, causing target opponent to lose life equal to twice Marionette Master's power.
Repeat.

1110-3197-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
1110-3197-5017.description:
Give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 4 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

914-1982-2034-3269-5311.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1982-2034-3269-5311.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Riftsweeper, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Sidisi by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Sidisi enters the battlefield, exploiting itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Ascend for Avernus and putting it into your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {5}{W}{W}{W}, returning Sidisi, Riftsweeper, and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and exiling Ascend from Avernus.
Sidisi, Riftsweeper, and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Riftsweeper trigger, shuffling Ascend from Avernus into your library from exile.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Riftsweeper, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger from step 10, exploiting itself.
Repeat from step 7.

759-1625-2970.description:
Cast Magister Sphinx by paying {4}{W}{U}{B}.
Magister Sphinx enters the battlefield, causing target opponent's life total to become ten.
Cast Aria of Flame by paying {2}{R}.
Aria of Flame enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose ten life.
The opponent whose life total was set in step 2 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1462-2148.description:
Cast Calming Verse by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate all lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the Calming Verse, destroying all permanents opponents control.

1525-2396-3681-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton and Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1525-2396-3681-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
